envVars.description: packages/hardhat/.env, optional. Chainlink AggregatorV3 feed used by MilestoneEscrow. Defaults: local networks deploy a MockPriceFeed; other networks use the Hedera testnet HBAR/USD feed.
packages/hardhat/.env, optional. Max Chainlink round age accepted at funding time (default 10800). Funding reverts with StalePrice beyond this.
packages/nextjs/.env.local, server-only, optional. Operator account (0.0.x) for the HCS audit mirror. Leave unset to run audit-disabled.
packages/nextjs/.env.local, server-only, optional. ECDSA private key (hex) for HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID. Never commit, never expose to the browser.
packages/nextjs/.env.local, server-only, optional. HCS topic (0.0.x) receiving escrow lifecycle messages. Create it with: npm run audit:create-topic -w @sh/nextjs
packages/nextjs/.env.local, server-only, optional. testnet (default) or mainnet for the HCS audit mirror.

steps.label: Deploy to it (seeds a $0.10 mock Chainlink feed locally)
Run the contract tests
steps.text: From packages/hardhat: npx hardhat test test/MilestoneEscrow.test.ts (offline, deterministic, no credentials).

sections.title: Run it locally (no Hedera account needed)

steps.label: Fund a deployer
steps.text: Generate an account (npm run hardhat:account:generate), then fund its EVM address with testnet HBAR at portal.hedera.com/faucet.

steps.label: Deploy against the live Chainlink HBAR/USD feed
Optional HCS audit mirror
steps.text: Set HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID / HEDERA_OPERATOR_KEY in packages/nextjs/.env.local, run npm run audit:create-topic -w @sh/nextjs, then set HEDERA_AUDIT_TOPIC_ID from the output.

description: USD-priced milestone escrow settled in HBAR on Hedera. Chainlink HBAR/USD prices every funding on-chain and funding reverts on a stale or incomplete round; escrow lifecycle events can mirror to an HCS audit topic. Next.js + Hardhat monorepo.
name: milestone-escrow
